moshi_turns.text: Hey, nice to hear from you. How are you?
Not many classic board games do, but party games handle it well. Word guessing in teams or hidden role games scale up nicely.
Games where a few people are secretly the bad guys and everyone else has to work out who. They're great for big groups and short rounds.
Then a team drawing or acting game is gentler. Nobody's on the spot alone, and shy people can just guess.
Mix it with smaller tables too, two or three games running at once, and let people move between them.
